Raised EPS guidance comes from costs and buybacks while 2026 organic revenue is now guided -2% to -1%, and management assumes no macro help in 2027, so the loss of exclusivity and share in key pet franchises looks structural even if livestock (+7%) and slower vet visits may partly recover. Watch dermatology share, Simparica Trio against NexGard, and the 2027 guide in February.
